text:
Ravi Patel: Reporting oddness: console p99 jumped at 10:12 but the endpoint split shows flat p99. timeline mismatch.

Sora Kim: Could be provenance: console uses merged tdigest rollup, endpoint pane queries per-backend raw samples. If rolls differ (retries, fallbacks) p99 won't match.

Ben Wallace: We also had a bucket-alignment quirk yesterday. Console used 10s buckets aligned to service timezone; endpoint uses UTC. That can create apparent desync during edge windows.

Ravi Patel: Ok. Proposal: add a tiny provenance badge next to p50/p95/p99 that lists "includes: retries? ingress/backend/fallback" and raw-sample-count. Also add a quick toggle to flip to raw-samples view for on-call.

Sora Kim: Love it. From API side let's expose /internal/telemetry/percentile_provenance?svc=... which returns flags and sample counts per-bucket. Keep it internal to avoid cost surprises.

Ben Wallace: Telemetry: schedule a daily drift check that injects 2% slow-fanout and compares merged_sketch_p99 vs raw_p99; alert if discrepancy > 10% for 3 runs.

telemetry-bot: scheduled job "pctl_provenance_drift" created, runs at 04:30 UTC daily.

Ravi Patel: Great. Also standardize bucket alignment to UTC everywhere and surface an annotation when routing weights or quota fallbacks change. That should cut a lot of noise.

Sora Kim: I'll prototype the badge copy and the toggle flow. Ben, can you add the provenance endpoint and the drift job?

Ben Wallace: On it. Will gate the endpoint behind ff and add a cheap cost-estimate tooltip when people flip to raw-samples.

Ravi Patel: Thanks all. If we ship the badge + toggle behind FF this week, ops can triage p99 pages without immediate oncall paging. :thumbsup:
